newsitem.title: USA: Health Professionals sees FY97 savings.
newsitem.headline: Health Professionals sees FY97 savings.

text.p: Health Professionals Inc said Monday it is consolidating executive and other personnel, a move that should generate savings which the company said will be recognized in the third quarter.

The company said it expects a net reduction of salaries and related expenses, after certain salary increases, of about $383,000, with annualized savings of about $532,000, for the fiscal year ending September 30.
The company did break out the amount it expects to save in the third quarter. A spokesman for the company was not available to elaborate.
